# heimdall

> A developer focused search engine for fresh, verified tech job opportunities collected directly from official company career pages and ATS providers. Not an aggregator.

## About

heimdall highlights recently posted engineering roles that are still live on the official source. Listings expire when the source removes them, so there are no ghost jobs.

## Where to look

- Search the live index: https://heimdall.daenerys.workers.dev
- Machine readable job list (JSON): https://heimdall.daenerys.workers.dev/api/jobs
- Latest fresh jobs (Markdown): https://heimdall.daenerys.workers.dev/llms-full.txt

## Data sources

- Official company career pages
- ATS providers: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable

## Freshness

- Default window hides roles posted more than 15 days ago
